content: UDS service request validation Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall provide a functionality to an external application to validate each UDS request according to ISO 14229-1. A validation can result in allowing to process the received request or in rejecting the request by discarding silently or returning an error code. Rationale: Restricting the execution of UDS requests via static configuration properties is not always sufficient and more dynamic checks are needed to achieve a further level of execution management. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Allow ECU projects or manufacturers to realize specific verifications that go beyond of what is available by standard AUTOSAR mechanism such as authentication or environmental conditions. An external application has access to the received request and implements own filter, firewall, etc on individual conditions.
